description: greedy as its Quick Start runs it: normalised cross-correlation over a 2x2x2 window, 100x50x10 iterations, the deformable stage alone; the picsl_greedy package at a pinned version. One modality only. The ImagingBenchmarks baseline greedy. CPU. The pair must be aligned (rigidly for one patient, by an affine transform between two subjects): only the deformable stage runs. Masks are ignored by this baseline. Output: the displacement field on the fixed grid, in mm along the world axes (ITK, LPS).
